ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
title: Steps Taken for Strengthening Allied Healthcare Workforce
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

Steps Taken for Strengthening Allied Healthcare Workforce

National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Profession has finalized 18 competency-based curriculums
Online enrolment portals for professionals and institutions were made live in October 2024 to facilitate central and state-level workforce mapping
29 States/UTs have constituted State Allied and Healthcare Councils for implementation and execution of provisions under NCAHP Act, 2021
Union Government announced additional 100,000 AHPs over next five years in Budget 2026
Rs. 1,000 Crore has been allocated this year for Allied Health Care Professionals

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
31 JUL 2026 2:36PM by PIB Delhi

The assessment and management of health workforce requirements is an ongoing and dynamic process carried out in coordination with State Governments and Union Territories based on evolving public health needs.

To establish a robust statutory mechanism for regulating allied and healthcare professions across 57 recognized categories, the Government enacted the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) Act, 2021, and constituted the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Profession (NCAHP) under the provisions of the Act. NCAHP has finalized 18 competency-based curriculum and online enrolment portals for professionals and institutions were made live in October 2024 to facilitate central and state-level workforce mapping. Furthermore, 29 States/UTs have constituted State Allied and Healthcare Councils for implementation and execution of the provisions under the Act.

To address the evolving demands for AHPs in healthcare ecosystem, the Central Government in Budget Announcement 2026, announced addition of 100,000 AHPs over next five years. Further, an amount of Rs.1000 Crore has been allocated in this year for the Scheme for Allied Health Care Professionals.

The Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare,
Smt. Anupriya Patel stated this in a written reply in the Lok Sabha today.

****

SR
